name: docs-manager
description: Treat docs as a product: auto-generated _index.md navigation, broken-link checks, text-source diagrams with typed refs and staleness tracking, a how-to for drawing ERDs that hold up, a method for keeping an agent instruction file (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md) small by moving project knowledge into the docs, cards that catalogue external reference files (pdf, docx, xlsx) with where-to-look maps and staleness checks, and the docs-as-product conventions. No renderer, no runtime, no dependencies.
